title: Finite Koszul comparison induces the normalized product-fiber comparison
statement: Let X be a scheme in universe u, A a commutative ring in universe u+1, d an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], and a : Fin r -> A any finite list, allowing r=0. On the canonical small model of the pro-etale site pull back the actual completed ring O [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete]. Let G be the explicitly constructed module-sheaf equivalence, applied termwise to complexes; b is the image of the scalar list. For each complex C let N=G(C), T the strict tensor-dual Koszul tower of N [def-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-system], and Gamma(C) the transported published exterior Koszul product fiber [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion]. There is an isomorphism of chain complexes e:G(Gamma(C)) ≅ roosF(T) [def-weil-strict-roos-model] carrying G of the actual (u,0) completion unit to the ordinary-limit unit of N followed by the inverse canonical termwise-limit comparison and roosι(T). This is an isomorphism of specified explicit complexes, before localization. No derived representative, derived-limit universal property, completeness or reflection appears in the statement.

proof.text: Use moduleSheaves_colimits_forgetful: the module-to-sheaf functor preserves and reflects limits, and restriction of scalars has the same underlying sheaf. Thus backward coefficient restriction preserves countable products. Compose with the site equivalence and use the finite level isomorphisms. Pi comparisons and projection extensionality prove that the product comparison intertwines 1-shift.

The additive mapping-cone comparison and its shift comparison transport the source mapping cocone. A commuting square with isomorphisms on both objects induces a mapping-cocone isomorphism. Identity on the source and minus identity on the target identify the negative and positive tower endomorphism fibers. Projection coordinates show that these comparisons carry each zero-homotopy lift to the specified zero-homotopy lift. All these general helper lemmas are proved in Lean.

Use the actual intrinsic round trip and the explicit natural isomorphism for applying composed functors to complexes. The finite augmentation equation identifies every product projection of the transported input map with the tensor-dual augmentation. The Roos augmentation factors through the ordinary limit. The canonical termwise-limit comparison and limit projection extensionality identify the resulting ordinary-limit map with ringedKoszulLimitUnit. This proves precisely the displayed unit equation, before localization.

lean.statement:
theorem completed_fiber_roos_comparison_on_complex
    (X : Scheme.{u}) {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (r : ℕ) (a : Fin r → A)
    (C : CochainComplex (pbcModules X (pbcAdicCompletion X d)) ℤ) :
    let O := completedCechRing X d
    let G := (completedCechModulesEquiv X d).functor.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let b := fun i ↦ completedCechScalar X d (a i)
    let N := G.obj C
    let T := ringedKoszulTensorTowerComplex O r b N
    ∃ e : G.obj (intrinsicCompletionComplex X d r a C) ≅ roosF.obj T,
      G.map (intrinsicCompletionComplexUnit X d r a C) ≫ e.hom =
        ringedKoszulLimitUnit O r b N ≫
          (completedKoszulTermwiseLimitIso.app T).inv ≫ roosι T
